title: MOMASPLAT: Dynamic Novel-View Demonstration Augmentation for Mobile Manipulation
abstract: arXiv:2611.08372v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Visuomotor policies trained through imitation learning are highly sensitive to changes in camera viewpoint. This is particularly problematic for mobile manipulation (MoMa), where robots rarely execute manipulation from the exact same base pose used during demonstration collection due to navigation uncertainty, localization drift, and environmental constraints. Recent approaches use novel-view synthesis (NVS) to augment demonstrations with unseen viewpoints, but they assume static scenes and therefore fail to re-render the manipulated object during the post-contact interaction phase, leaving the most critical parts of the demonstration unaugmented. We present MOMASPLAT, a novel-view demonstration augmentation framework for mobile manipulation that synthesizes full manipulation trajectories from unseen robot base poses, including dynamic object interactions. translated_title: MOMASPLAT：面向移动操作的动态新视角示范增强
translated_abstract: 通过模仿学习训练的视觉运动策略对相机视角的变化高度敏感。这对于移动操作而言尤其成问题，因为由于导航不确定性、定位漂移和环境约束，机器人很少能从与示范数据采集时完全相同的底盘位姿来执行操作任务。近期的方法使用新视角合成（NVS）技术用未见过的视角来增强示范数据，但它们假设场景是静态的，因此无法在接触后的交互阶段重新渲染被操作的物体，导致示范中最关键的部分未能得到增强。我们提出了MOMASPLAT，一个面向移动操作的新视角示范增强框架，能够从未见过的机器人底盘位姿合成完整的操作轨迹，包括动态的物体交互。我们的关键洞察是，标准的移动操作数据采集过程天然地提供了多（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: MOMASPLAT提出了一个面向移动操作的新视角示范增强框架，能够从未见过的机器人底盘位姿合成包含动态物体交互的完整操作轨迹，克服了现有新视角合成方法因假设静态场景而无法增强接触后关键交互阶段的局限。
en_tdlr: MOMASPLAT is a novel-view demonstration augmentation framework for mobile manipulation that synthesizes full manipulation trajectories, including dynamic object interactions, from unseen robot base poses, overcoming the static-scene limitation of prior novel-view synthesis methods that fail to augment the critical post-contact interaction phase.
